description: This file defines a React component named EfSourceMappingTab, which manages the EF Source Mapping functionality within an asset details page. It includes state management, data fetching, form handling, modal dialog for creating or editing mappings, and rendering a data table with actions. The component interacts with external API endpoints for listing, creating, and updating EF source mappings.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches the list of EF source mappings for the selected asset and input parameter, updating the component's rows state.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new EF source mapping and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares the form with the selected row data for editing and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving the form data to create or update an EF source mapping via API calls, with validation, error handling, and UI updates.
